'''Plastoid tape''' was a type of tape. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] deserter [[Sull]] was captured on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]] by the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] and [[Darman Skirata|Darman]], and Atin subsequently tied [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] tape around Sull's ankles.<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>{{Tech-stub}}
